params.prompt: Premium smooth 3D render icon, square 1:1, plain dark warm background (#0B0907). The single object is placed in the lower-right quadrant of the frame; the upper-left 60% of the frame stays nearly black and empty. Soft warm rim light, one subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow beneath the object, matte and brushed-metal materials, shallow depth of field. No text, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no green. Object: a dark matte gift box with a thin brushed-gold ribbon and bow, the lid slightly lifted with warm yellow light spilling out from inside — bonuses that stay with you.
